diagnostic_metrics: public-page visitor to qualified estimate-request start rate by intent cluster
median time from first request capture to first human response
share of accepted requests missing required site details, photos, or scope notes
share of site visits assigned with an accountable estimator
evidence_sources: product request, site-visit, and quote-ready records
attributed quote and won-work records from an operator-approved integration or manual reconciliation
Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools after ownership is verified
crawler and server logs that exclude secrets and private content

experiment_policy.output: reviewable source change with hypothesis and evidence

forbidden_actions: fabricate backlinks, reviews, citations, mentions, customers, or outcomes
expose private query or customer data
outcome_metrics: median time from qualified request to quote-ready decision
won work attributable to a completed quote-ready package
primary_conversion_event: A prospective buyer submits a qualified estimate request with contact details, service location, requested work, and consent to follow up.
review_cadence: Review diagnostic metrics weekly after launch and commercial outcomes monthly only when identity, consent, and attribution are available.
